title: Gwajin Dutsen Bakarare
intro: Al'umma, mai ƙwarewa da alfahari, ta sassaka gadonsu a kan tsaunuka. Amma lokacin da aka aiko musu da wata alama bayyananna, jarabawar imani da kamewa, girman kansu ya kai su ga hanyar da ba za a iya komawa baya ba. Za ku iya gano wannan rukunin da kuma sakamakon rashin biyayyarsu?
clues: Mun kasance ƙwararrun masu fasaha a fannin duwatsu, muna sassaka gidaje masu kyau kai tsaye a gefen tsaunuka.
Wani manzo daga cikin mutanenmu ya zo mana, yana kiranmu mu bauta wa Allah ɗaya tilo na gaskiya.
Mun nemi wata alama don tabbatar da maganarsa, aka kuma fito da wata halitta ta musamman a matsayin jarabawa a gare mu.
An ba mu umarni mai sauƙi: mu raba tushen ruwanmu da wannan halitta, mu bar shi ya sha a ranar da aka ƙayyade.
Cikin girman kai, wasu daga cikinmu sun yi makirci muka ƙi gargaɗin, muka kashe halittar da aka yi niyya ta zama alamarmu.
An ba mu kwana uku kafin halakarmu, sannan aka yi wata babbar fashewa a gidajenmu, ta bar mu babu rai kuma ta kife.

trial.label: Menene Jarrabawarmu ta Farko?
options: Gina jirgi don tsira daga ambaliyar ruwa
Yin tsayayya da sha'awar kamun kifi a ranar Asabar
Jure wa yunwa ta shekaru bakwai

outcome.label: Menene Makomarmu ta Ƙarshe?
options: An nutsar da shi cikin babban ambaliyar ruwa
Iska mai ƙarfi ta mamaye shi
An lalata ta da wata babbar fashewa/girgizar ƙasa
outcome.answer: An lalata ta da wata babbar fashewa/girgizar ƙasa

arabic: فَعَقَرُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةَ وَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰصَـٰلِحُ ٱئْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: So they hamstrung the she-camel and were insolent toward the command of their Lord and said, "O Ṣāliḥ, bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the messengers." (7:77)
